name: STAR Orbit — strict reader of two-line element sets
summary: Reads every field of a NORAD two-line element set as printed (Alpha-5 included) and refuses malformed sets with a machine-readable reason; fields equal to python-sgp4 and Orekit within 6e-14, and stricter than both on malformed input.
reference: The two-line element set format (NORAD / Space-Track) with its worked example: ISS (ZARYA), 1 25544U 98067A 08264.51782528 -.00002182 00000-0 -11606-4 0 2927 / 2 25544 51.6416 247.4627 0006703 130.5360 325.0288 15.72125391563537; SGP4 verification catalogue SGP4-VER.TLE (Vallado et al. 2006)
reference_observed: every field and both checksums of the worked example reproduced exactly; 29/29 well-formed sets of the catalogue read with every field equal to the printed text

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: units as printed in the TLE (degrees, revolutions per day, 1/earth radii), named in the keys
review.G-06: fixtures/SGP4-VER.TLE from the SGP4 verification distribution; malformed corpus derived with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: TleError with a reason for every malformed input; nothing is repaired; no iteration
